observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha PSR-style electronic keyboard with built-in speakers on both sides and a central LCD/control panel.
The model text appears on the panel area; it looks like 'PSR-175' (partially readable).
No close-up of the screen content, buttons/knobs, ports, or power/volume controls.
No visible damage, but overall condition (keys wear, casing cracks, missing knobs) is not fully verifiable from this single wide shot.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show it being powered on, playing audio, or any test results.

claims.claim: it's used please note but working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a used-looking keyboard, but usage level and performance condition are not provable remotely.

risks.risk: Not actually working (dead keys, faulty speakers, broken power supply, stuck buttons/knobs).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on + LCD working + playing several keys + demonstrating volume/speaker output (and ideally a few buttons like style/voice).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully verified/possibly needing repair (worst case: treat as not working until tested).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete setup (power adapter, sustain pedal, manuals).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter/pedal/manual) and a close-up of the keyboard’s charging/power port.
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard only (no accessories) until inclusion is confirmed.

risks.risk: LCD/controls may be partially faulty (faint display, intermittent buttons).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the LCD while on, plus a video showing repeated button presses without glitches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential display/control issue (worst case: assume faults possible).

risks.risk: Physical wear or damage not obvious in the wide shot (key wobble, cracked casing, missing knobs).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full keybed (top and sides), both speaker grilles, and the control knob/button area.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a lower tier for used condition with unknown wear.

proof_requests: Send a video: power-on, LCD clearly visible, play a short melody across multiple octaves, and show speakers output.
Show a close-up of the model label/serial area (to confirm PSR-175) and the power/charging port.
List and show included items (power adapter, sustain pedal, any cables/manuals).
Close-up photos of keys (front edge + any missing/loose keys) and the control panel (knobs/buttons).
response.reason: The photos identify a Yamaha PSR-175, but the seller’s key claim that it is 'working perfectly' is not verifiable from a single non-powered image. To price safely, we need a power-on/play test video and confirmation of included accessories.
